messages:
alex: seeing a weird double-charge pattern in prod for streaming sessions where client cancels prefetch and then reconnects. session=abc123. toolcall cost appears twice for the same logical operation. anyone seen this?

priya: can you drop the minimal logs + timeline?

alex: logging snippet: ```
[14:01:12] PREPREFETCH_CANCEL session=abc123 token=ephemeral-xyz
[14:01:15] RESUME_START session=abc123 route=eu-west-1 shard=3
[14:01:16] TOOLCALL_INVOKE id=tool-append-42 session=abc123
[14:01:16] STREAM_TRUNCATE reason=swap seq=255
[14:01:16] BILLING provisional session=abc123 tokens=120 source=stream-prefix
[14:01:17] BILLING provisional session=abc123 tokens=120 source=toolcall
```

mike: that log makes it look like the resume path replayed a prefetch/snapshot chunk AND the toolcall was charged separately. if the resume includes the same prefix tokens plus a toolcall, we might be double-crediting. is this ephemeral session pinned to a different shard on resume?

alex: yes, client went to a different shard due to placement. ephemeral session token was not stable across reconnects. router routed to shard 5 on first attempt and shard 3 on resume. the snapshot/kv state didn't travel.

liz: quick thought: dedupe by origin id + sequence overlap when finalizing charges. add origin_id to ledger entries and when we finalize provisional charges, merge overlapping ranges.

priya: we already have origin_id in hosted API traces but not in Private/VPC. also consoles & billing batch pipeline assume each provisional item is independent. schema change + backfill needed.

mike: alternative (safer): keep provisional charges until EOF, only finalize on a closed stream. if a resume occurs, check whether the resumed prefix was previously finalized. This avoids adding new identifiers but means provisional values remain visible longer.

ops-bot: incident alert: billing spike detected for customer acme-io at 14:02 UTC related to streaming toolcalls. investigation in progress.

alex: immediate low-risk change: router should not re-emit prefetch snapshot events on resume if a recent provisional ledger record exists for that session id + shard mismatch. conservative guard: 2s grace window.

liz: i'll update console: add a per-route provisional vs finalized counter and a small "suspected-dedupe" diff column to highlight sessions with overlapping provisional tokens.

priya: action items: alex -> small router guard PR to avoid re-emitting prefetch when recent provisional exists; mike -> telemetry schema change plan for origin_id (and tracelet fallback); liz -> console panel + provisional/finalized diff; i'll coordinate billing batch changes for safe reconciliation. i'll open an umbrella issue.

alex: thanks. i'll post PR link when ready.

mike: PR opened: https://git.redwood.local/prefetch-dedupe - adds X-Origin-Session header + checks ledger provisional window before replaying prefetch events.

alex: nice. :thumbsup:

liz: i'll prototype the console diff this afternoon and share screenshots here.

priya: leaving notes for postmortem: ensure telemetry + billing pipeline can reconcile provisional overlaps and add a small refund flow for customers hit by this.

alex: will follow up with a short postmortem once we confirm the fix. thanks all.
